Hello! East West University (EWU) is a well-known private university located in Aftabnagar, Dhaka, Bangladesh. It was founded in 1996 and offers a variety of undergraduate and graduate programs across multiple fields, including Business and Economics, Computer Science & Engineering, Law, English, Pharmacy, and more. The university is recognized for its focus on education and academic development, with English as the medium of instruction. 

If you have any specific questions about EWU or its programs, feel free to ask!
